==About==

{{i|Valentine Candies}} were given out by the [[Developers]] on Valentines Day. Unlike other {{i|Candies}}, Valentine Candies Reduced rather than Restored Food Groups with the Food Group and amount being random. There are 5 different Valentine's Candies:
*{{i|Be My Belgear}}
*{{i|BBQ BBY}}
*{{i|Marp + JC Grandma}}
*{{i|Sexy Pilgrim}}
*{{i|Woodshed2nite}}
